initialize_pytorch_dist_backend: initialize a PyTorchDistBackend instance with bootstrap_info and commsParams for distributed training
run_all_reduce_collective: run an all_reduce collective operation with optional quantization on float32 tensors across ranks
run_all_to_all_collective: run an all_to_all collective operation with optional quantization and batched embedding table support
run_gemm_compute: run a matrix multiplication compute kernel using torch.matmul or triton_matmul based on config
initialize_process_groups: initialize additional process groups from a rank mapping dictionary with a specified backend
